sentences.text: Sunil Rakhan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 April, 2025

Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Gwl:8202
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Gwalior

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Rajendra Kumar Vani

On The 9 th Of April, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 11268 of 2025
 Sunil Rakhan
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Shobhendra Kumar Tiwari - Advocate for the applican
 Shri Saket Udeniya- Public Prosecutor for the respondent
 Shri Ayush Chourasia - Advocate for the complainant.

Order 
This first application has been filed by the applicant under Section 482 of BNSS (Section 438 of Cr.P.C.) for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant, who is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.21/2025 registered at Police Station -Cantt.Guna, District - Guna (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 of IPC.

2 . The allegation against the applicant is that he committed fraud with the complainant for taking money through a cheque from her in lieu of plot.
3.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that there is no document on record that present applicant was involved in the sale transaction to the complainant Anurag.
He is nowhere related with the offence.

He has been implicated in this case on the basis of a cheque of Rs.25,000/-,
but why the cheque has been submitted to the present applicant is not clarified by the prosecution.
Though he has encashed the cheque but he was not known of the transaction of the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:8202 2 MCRC-11268-2025 offence allegedly committed.
He has no criminal history.
Co-accused Vinod has been granted regular bail by this Court.
The applicant is ready and willing to co- operate in the investigation and abide by all the terms and conditions as may be imposed by this Court.
On these grounds, learned counsel for the applicant prays for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant.
4. Per contra , learned counsel for the respondent/State as well as the counsel for the complainant have opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.

sentences.text: 5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

6. Considering the submissions made by learned counsel for the parties and the facts and circumstances of the case and that aforesaid similarly situated co- accused has been released on bail, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that in case, if the applicant appears before the Investigating Officer/trial Court within fifteen days from today and furnishes personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only) with one surety to the satisfaction of the concerned Investigating Officer/trial Court, then she shall be released on anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: This order shall be effective till the end of trial.
However, in case of breach of any of the precondition of bail, the Trial Court may consider on merit cancellation of bail without any impediment of this order.
9. The Trial Court shall get these conditions reproduced on the personal bond by the accused and on surety bond by the surety concerned.
If any of them is unable to write, the scribe shall certify that he had explained the conditions to the concerned accused or the surety.
